headline: Fronts Stir Along Palantine and Marban Lines
war_summary: Since the last edition, Palantine Berm has become the liveliest contested sector, logging ten strategic-base events in two hours and thirty-six across the day; its present ledger shows three Colonial, two Warden, and two neutral bases. Marban Hollow has likewise quickened, with three events in the latest two hours and twenty-three in twenty-four, retaining a divided count of four Colonial, three Warden, and one neutral. Linn Mercy remains under the heaviest immediate pressure, recording six events in six hours and seventeen in the day; the current count is nine Colonial, one Warden, and one neutral. Weathered Expanse has reopened after the earlier lull, with three events in two hours and nineteen across the day, while six Warden, one Colonial, and two neutral bases stand reported. Nevish Line also shows renewed movement, with two recent events and eight daily. Mooring County has been quiet for six hours but still leads the day’s event total at twenty-five. The war remains without a declared victor.
